title: Cover contract through the BIA near White Sands
place_text: sovereign nation near White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico

tellings.quote: we had a a cover contract through the BIA, which is the Bureau of Indian Affairs at a sovereign nation close to White Sands uh missile range in New Mexico.

plain: In 2001 a secret team worked under a cover contract with the Bureau of Indian Affairs, the US agency that deals with Native American tribes, on a sovereign tribal nation close to White Sands Missile Range in New Mexico. That is how Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he flew a recovered UFO, describes it, and he says he was part of it. If true, it would mean UFO work was hidden behind ordinary government contracts.
